description: This file defines Express.js route handlers for the dashboard modules API, providing overview metrics and counts related to users, tenants, projects, sessions, deployments, and costs. It imports models and services, handles asynchronous data fetching, and exposes endpoints for frontend consumption.

methods.name: GET /api/dashboard/overview/modules
methods.description: Handles GET requests to /modules, fetching counts and metrics for dashboard overview, with fallback logic for user count estimation.

methods.name: GET /api/dashboard/overview/metrics
methods.description: Handles GET requests to /metrics, providing total counts for users and deployments, with fallback for user count estimation.
